## Problem

What are you trying to do, and where does wrkspc get in the way today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Describe the behavior you want — concrete is
better than a label.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why they fall short.

## Scope check

wrkspc is deliberately small: a hub that owns the shared record and
the rules, nodes that execute, and moderation the operator controls
in-band. Requests that respect that authority boundary — visible
delivery, human-gated execution, no silent unknowns — are the best
fit.
